title: Monthly pay
statementMd:
Show each employee's first name and monthly salary (annual salary divided by 12), rounded to 2 decimals.

Expected columns: `first_name`, `monthly_salary`.

Tables: `employees`, `departments`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT first_name, ROUND(salary / 12.0, 2) AS monthly_salary FROM employees;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
